title: Suspension of Frost Salamander Tongue
summary: Alchemical extract used for Oil of Freezing.

fields.Extract: Combine 3 Frost Salamander Tongues to make one Suspension of Frost Salamander Tongue.
fields.Brew: Combine this extract with any Sublimate to make Oil of Freezing.
fields.Recipe discrepancy: The extract page lists Ash. The oil and shared Alchemy sources list Sublimate.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
